population: Recovered 2026 Scopus Business, Management and Accounting export corpus
estimand: Core and interdisciplinary business papers whose abstract-visible workflow appeared autonomously feasible with public digital inputs

exclusion.label: Technical and computational cross-field
exclusion.reason: Primary research question was technical or computational rather than business or management

limitations: The denominator is the recovered export corpus, not the full Scopus result count.
Weights derive from a small probability audit and fine taxonomy cells remain exploratory.
The 10.20% value is an opportunity envelope, not an observed AI authorship or autonomous completion rate.
Annual corpus re-audits are required before changing these weights.
